title: Simple
body: I like the app and how simple it is but considering that I’m paying, I should have more organisation control and be able to plan the next day. It’s weird there isn’t a calendar where I can plan ahead a little. I like making my to do list before bed for example (or may be it stays there if I add there before bed?). Also the times reminder that I put in for majority of the habits and tasks were gone when I woke up the next day. I don’t want to spend my mornings organising an app to my liking. I should be able to do it before bed and as far into the future I like
author: Shjomla
